about: Every word on Study 85's page that is ours or the club's, by id (85.<slot>). x.* is shared; a.*, b.*, c.*, d.* belong to one option each (a Untangle, b Exploded View, c Taken Apart, d Prism). build.cjs puts them on the page and writes copy.json. flag: draft = ours, italic; label = ours, wayfinding; sourced = the club's words verbatim (the workshop 2 board by element, the brand guide), see src, upright; chrome = round 4's nav, footer, next. The club's live home page line is shown only as a picture of the page (img/front.png), never transcribed: it sits outside the 46-50 sources. 'pending' holds what is never rendered until sourced.

quote.note: Every option: the client pride quote. Hidden until a verbatim founder line is supplied and cleared. A candidate exists outside the 46-50 sources (Study 42's check.cjs, a founder on the personas, 15 May); it is NOT used until Kahran clears it.
